assay: bulk RNA-seq of mouse tibialis anterior, STAR + DESeq2 per GEO data_processing
primary_estimand: Acute effect of unilateral high-force eccentric contractions (electrically stimulated sciatic nerve, harvested 4 h later) vs the contralateral non-stimulated TA, within mouse, in young (4 mo) vehicle-treated males.
planned_contrasts: Stim vs Non-Stim TA, young vehicle, paired by mouse (abstract: increased load lowered Arrdc2, not Arrdc3; no DEG count in abstract)
repeated_measure_unit: mouse (Stim and Non-Stim leg of the same animal)
sample_inclusion: Vehicle arm only for this paper; DEX arms belong to the glucocorticoid question of the later papers that the series also cites (PMIDs 39495237, 40880111).

paper_threshold.source_locator: not stated in abstract; GEO data_processing: DESeq2 default, BH FDR
